reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend pair and relies on every caller already passing its config to it, so holidays reach all paths without new call-site logic.

duplication.why: The non-working-day predicate is defined once (isNonWorkingDay); only the scan-window padding '+ holidays.length' is repeated in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: Holiday handling sits in shared/schedules.ts inside the existing weekend-rule helpers.

scope.why: Type, parse, helper and tests only, plus the scan window.

maintainability.why: Clean extension of one shared rule; the scan-window sizing is a separate per-caller concern (and getDatesInRange's WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS was not revisited), which a maintainer must remember.

disguised_duplication.where: none; the window padding is repeated verbatim rather than disguised

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay used by getDateWithWeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template all call
